set.body: Plan: raise the graphics plot system from a solid 8/10 to a cleaner 9/10 by reducing hand-wired compiler repetition, making trained scales drive guides, turning layout into a real allocation contract, and making backend conformance reusable. Acceptance: internal typed aesthetic environment, explicit compiler phases, automatic guide derivation, plot layout solver, and reusable renderer conformance harness, all preserving the renderer-neutral Plot -> resolved IR -> Scene -> backend pipeline and verified on JVM and JS.
set.title: Epic: graphics elegance hardening to 9/10
